summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for ezeserve QR ordering system after merge-conflict recovery. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases passed after fixing a MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in POST /api/admin/users. Frontend: all critical flows (login no-signup, dashboard, kanban orders, manual order modal, billing with filters, super-admin user mgmt, purple gradient sidebar) verified end-to-end via Playwright.

minor.issue: Originally returned 500 due to MongoDB _id being included in response dict (TypeError: ObjectId is not iterable). Fixed in this run by excluding _id from response.

action_items: Self-test the /api/admin/users 500 fix end-to-end (already verified by pytest). All 20 backend tests + all UI flows now pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has multiple endpoints returning `{k: v for k, v in doc.items() if k != '_id'}` boilerplate after insert_one – consider a helper to remove duplication.
JWT tokens have NO expiry (`exp` claim missing in create_token). This is a security risk – tokens are valid forever until JWT_SECRET rotates.
POST /api/orders is public (correct for QR flow) but lacks rate limiting or any restaurant_id existence validation – a bad actor could spam orders for nonexistent restaurants.
verify_password / hash_password are synchronous bcrypt calls inside async endpoints – will block event loop under load. Consider running in a threadpool.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Should use explicit origin list.
No httpOnly cookie auth – tokens are returned in JSON, so frontend likely stores them in localStorage (XSS risk).
AdminLogin.js, AdminOrders.js, etc. – all good with data-testids. AdminOrders.js is large (~500+ lines), consider splitting Kanban / OrderModal / ManualOrderModal into separate files.
seed_super_admin only seeds when missing; does not update password if env ADMIN_PASSWORD changes (non-idempotent for password rotation).
test_credentials: Super Admin admin@ezeserve.com / admin123 (seeded). Restaurant admins are dynamically created in fixtures with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Test data created via fixtures: 2 TEST_ restaurants, 2 TEST_ restaurant admins, multiple TEST_ orders/bills. Not cleaned up – consider adding teardown if running repeatedly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py – run with `pytest backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Websocket test uses websockets lib (installed). WebSocket endpoints are mounted on app directly (not api_router) but path uses /api prefix so ingress routing works. The previously-broken POST /api/admin/users (ObjectId serialization) is now fixed.
rca of the issue: POST /api/admin/users returned 500 because after `await db.admin_users.insert_one(doc)`, motor mutates `doc` in-place adding a BSON ObjectId at key `_id`. The response dict was built as `{k: v for k, v in doc.items() if k != 'password'}` which preserved `_id`. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder then failed: `TypeError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable`. Fix: also exclude `_id` (mirrors the same pattern used in all other POST endpoints in the file). Verified via re-run of full pytest suite – all 20 cases green.
